items.raw_excerpt: Swiss petrol prices fall slightly from their record-high levels; Zurich cracks down on Airbnbs in residential areas to reclaim housing; and more news in our roundup this Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Swiss petrol prices fell a little from their record highs. Zurich is cracking down on Airbnb rentals in homes to bring back housing for residents.

items.raw_excerpt: An expert says there is virtually nothing passengers can do once they are aboard a bed bug infested flight but suggests places where to start looking for the critters.
items.summary_en: An expert says passengers can do almost nothing once bed bugs are already on a plane. He suggests where to look for the insects and how to deal with them.

items.raw_excerpt: October 13 is 'International Day for Failure', a now-global initiative that has its origins on a Finnish university campus.
items.summary_en: October 13 is the International Day for Failure. The idea started on a Finnish university campus and has now spread around the world.

items.raw_excerpt: The settlement follows the largest group legal action brought by midwives in the UK, says union.
items.summary_en: Midwives in the UK reached a settlement with the NHS over exposure to nitrous oxide at work. The union called the payout a landmark result. It is the largest group legal action brought by midwives in the country.
items.summary_ko: 영국의 조산사들이 직장 내 아산화질소 노출 문제로 NHS와 합의에 이르렀다. 노동조합은 이번 보상을 역사적 성과라고 불렀다. 이 소송은 영국 조산사들이 제기한 집단 소송 중 가장 큰 규모다.
items.title_en: UK midwives win landmark payout over nitrous oxide exposure

items.title_original: NHS staff get 'landmark' payout over nitrous oxide exposure

items.raw_excerpt: An air patrol volunteer for Coastguard says he has major safety concerns for boaties in the upper North Island after two teams were grounded.
items.summary_en: A Coastguard air patrol volunteer says new safety rules are a knee-jerk response. Two volunteer teams in the upper North Island have been grounded, and he fears for boaties' safety.
items.summary_ko: 해안경비대 항공 순찰 자원활동가가 새로운 안전 규정을 무리한 대응이라고 비판했습니다. 상부 노스아일랜드의 두 자원대가 활동이 중단되어, 그는 보트 이용자들의 안전이 걱정된다고 말했습니다.
items.title_en: Coastguard air volunteers grounded over new safety rules
items.title_ko: 신규 안전 규정으로 해안경비대 항공 자원대 활동 중단
items.title_original: 'Knee jerk response' - Coastguard air volunteers grounded over safety rule changes

items.summary_en: Students gathered at Syntagma square in Athens to protest. They asked for better student housing and lower costs of studying. The protest was held outside the Ministry of Finance.

items.raw_excerpt: Canberran V8 Supercars rookie Zach Bates is on track to reach the pole position of his career after finishing third at the Bathurst 1000 on Sunday.
items.summary_en: Canberra racing driver Zach Bates finished third at the Bathurst 1000 on Sunday. The young V8 Supercars rookie is now close to the best grid spot of his career. He said he put everything on the line in the race.
items.summary_ko: 캔버라의 레이싱 드라이버 잭 베이츠가 일요일 바스처 1000 경기에서 3위에 올랐다. 젊은 V8 슈퍼카스 루키인 그는 이번 대회 통틀어 최고의 출발 순위에 근접했다. 그는 경기에서 자신이 모든 것을 걸었다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Canberra rookie Zach Bates finishes third at Bathurst 1000

items.raw_excerpt: On Tuesday night, temperatures across many parts of the country will dip below zero degrees.
items.summary_en: Most parts of Finland will be sunny on Tuesday night. Temperatures will drop below zero, and rain will arrive on Wednesday.

items.title_en: Finland mostly sunny on Tuesday before rain on Wednesday

items.raw_excerpt: Dr Allison Gardner MP has been living with the "searing pain" of recurring infections for a decade.
items.summary_en: Allison Gardner, a British member of Parliament, has dealt with recurring urinary tract infections for 10 years. She says the constant pain made her feel like a drug user. She wants better care for people with long-term infections.
items.summary_ko: 영국 하원의원 앨리슨 가드너는 10년 동안 다시 돌아오는 요로감염을 겪어 왔습니다. 그녀는 반복되는 통증 때문에 마약 사용자처럼 느껴졌다고 말했습니다. 그녀는 오래된 감염을 앓는 사람들에게 더 나은 치료가 필요하다고 주장했습니다.
items.title_en: MP Shares Her 10 Years of Painful Infections
items.title_ko: 영국 하원의원, 10년간의 통증 이야기 고백
items.title_original: Chronic UTIs made MP 'feel like a drug user'

items.raw_excerpt: The Chinese Professional Baseball League's (CPBL) Taiwan Series will begin at Taipei Dome on Saturday after the CTBC Brothers beat the Uni-Lions 8-2 on Monday to claim the last spot in the championship.
items.summary_en: The Taiwan Series of the Chinese Professional Baseball League starts on Saturday at Taipei Dome. CTBC Brothers beat the Uni-Lions 8-2 on Monday to claim the last spot in the championship. All games of the series will be played at Taipei Dome.
items.summary_ko: 중국프로야구리그 타이완 시리즈가 토요일 타이베이돔에서 시작된다. CTBC 브러더스는 월요일 유니 라이언스를 8-2로 물리치고 마지막 결승 진출 자리를 차지했다. 이번 시리즈 모든 경기는 타이베이돔에서 열린다.
items.title_en: Taiwan Series to open Saturday at Taipei Dome
items.title_ko: 타이완 시리즈, 토요일 타이베이돔에서 개막
items.title_original: Taiwan Series to open Saturday, with all games at Taipei Dome

items.raw_excerpt: Villagers near Bhogapuram airport in Vizianagaram say construction vehicles damaged their roads, cutting them off from fields; passengers seek service road access.
items.summary_en: Construction vehicles damaged roads near the Bhogapuram airport site in Vizianagaram, India. Villages are now cut off, and farmers cannot reach their fields. People want a service road so they can pass.
items.summary_ko: 인도 비자나그람의 부가푸람 공항 건설 현장에서 공사 차량이 마을 도로를 망가뜨렸다. 마을과 밭이 끊어져 농민들이 농지에 접근하지 못하고 있다. 주민들은 지나갈 수 있도록 서비스 도로를 달라고 요구하고 있다.
items.title_en: Roads damaged during Bhogapuram airport construction leave villages cut off

items.title_original: Roads damaged during Bhogapuram airport construction leave villages cut off, farmers unable to reach fields

items.raw_excerpt: Kinship carers Alan and Julie are full-time guardians to Ella, who has severe disabilities.
items.summary_en: Alan and Julie are full-time carers for their grandchild Ella, who has severe disabilities. They had only 10 minutes to decide whether to look after her.
items.summary_ko: 앨런과 줄리는 심각한 장애가 있는 손녀 엘라를 전임으로 돌보고 있습니다. 두 사람은 엘라를 돌보기로 할지 10분 만에 결정해야 했습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Saigon River pedestrian bridge in downtowwn Ho Chi Minh City is scheduled to have its main arch joined on Oct. 21, following successful factory load tests on its 3,400-ton arch structure and supporting frame ahead of transportation to the installation site.
items.summary_en: A nipa palm-shaped pedestrian bridge over the Saigon River in downtown Ho Chi Minh City will have its main arch joined on Oct. 21. The 3,400-ton arch passed factory load tests before being moved to the installation site.
items.summary_ko: 호찌민시 중심부 사이공강 위에 건설 중인 야자수 모양의 보행교가 10월 21일 주 arch 연결 작업을 진행한다. 3,400톤짜리 주 arch는 공장 하중 시험을 통과한 뒤 설치 현장으로 옮겨졌다.
items.title_en: Saigon River pedestrian bridge to join main arch on Oct. 21
items.title_ko: 사이공강 보행교, 10월 21일 주 arch 연결
items.title_original: Saigon River nipa palm-shaped pedestrian bridge set to be joined on Oct 21

items.raw_excerpt: Vizianagaram Collector ordered GMR to repair roads near Bhogapuram airport damaged during its construction, after The Hindu reported villages were cut off.
items.summary_en: The Vizianagaram Collector ordered GMR to fix roads damaged during the Bhogapuram airport construction. Villages near the site had been cut off, and the order came after The Hindu reported the problem. The repair work will reconnect the affected villages.
items.summary_ko: 비자야나가람 지방 행정관이 보가푸람 공항 건설 과정에서 파손된 도로의 복구를 GMR에 지시했다. 현장 인근 마을들이 고립된 상태였으며, 지시는 이 문제를 보도한 뒤에 나왔다. 복구 공사는 단절된 마을들을 다시 연결하게 된다.
items.title_en: Collector Orders GMR to Repair Roads Damaged Near Bhogapuram Airport
items.title_ko: 비자야나가람 Collector, 보가푸람 공항 건설로 파손된 도로 복구 지시
items.title_original: After The Hindu report, Collector orders GMR to repair roads damaged in Bhogapuram airport construction

items.raw_excerpt: Ouvert depuis samedi 10 octobre, l’espace traditionnel de ventes, de restauration, de rencontres et d’exposition dédiés au cinéma du Festival Lumière est enfin ouvert, une première à l’Hôtel-Dieu de Lyon.
items.summary_en: A special village for the Festival Lumiere opened on Saturday, October 10. It is the first time the event is held at the Hotel-Dieu in Lyon. Visitors can buy DVDs and books, join film talks, and see exhibitions.
items.summary_ko: 뤼미에르 영화제의 마을이 10월 10일 토요일 문을 열었다. 이번에는 리옹 호텔디외에서 처음 열리는 행사다. 방문객은 DVD와 책을 사고 영화 관련 만남과 전시도 즐길 수 있다.
items.title_en: Lyon: The Festival Lumiere Village Is Now Open
items.title_ko: 리옹 뤼미에르 영화제 마을 개장…DVD·책·영화 만남 열려

items.raw_excerpt: Was hat die Berndorf Immobilien AG mit einem neuen Stadtquartier in Mödling zu tun? Sie hilft mit, dass auf ehemaligen Industriegrund neues Leben einzieht.
items.summary_en: A former industrial site in Mödling, Austria, is being turned into a new city quarter called Bern.Dorf. Real estate company Berndorf Immobilien AG is helping lead the project. A building called Holz.Palast will stand at the center of the new neighborhood.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아 뫼들링의 옛 공업 부지가 베른도르프라는 이름의 새 도시 구역으로 탈바꿈하고 있다. 부동산 개발사 베른도르프 부동산 주식회사가 이 사업을 이끌고 있다. 이 새 동네 한가운데에는 홀츠팔라스트라는 건물이 들어선다.
items.title_en: New city quarter takes shape in Mödling

items.title_original: Holz.Palast als neues Zentrum des Stadtquartiers Bern.Dorf in Mödling - NÖN.at - Niederösterreichische Nachrichten

items.raw_excerpt: A team replaces 75 metres (246ft) of old tarmac every night over three months of the runway.
items.summary_en: A work crew replaces 75 metres of old tarmac on a busy runway every night over three months. The airport keeps the runway open for flights during the day while the repairs go on at night.

items.title_en: Replacing a busy runway while planes keep flying

items.summary_en: South African students have started their final school exams. The tests began with Computer Applications Technology and several language subjects.

items.raw_excerpt: We all know that a stitch in time saves nine, but if you're not too handy with a needle France has plenty of options for getting clothes altered or repaired. Here is what to look for, prices and the government 'repair bonus'.
items.summary_en: An article explains where in France to get clothes repaired or altered, what it costs, and how the government repair bonus works. It offers practical tips for people who are not handy with a needle.

items.summary_en: Italy has rules about when people in certain buildings can turn on heating. These rules also limit how long heating can run and how high the temperature can be set.
